subject: Default priors for poisson hurdle model

messages.author: 526e3a07ee4e96cf
messages.subject: Default priors for poisson hurdle model
parts:
Hello, I am interested in fitting a poisson hurdle model using the "zeroinflatedbinomial0" likelihood.  I was wondering what the default priors are for parameters in the bernoulli portion, p=inverse logit(\theta).  The documentation states:

Zeroinflated Binomial Type 0 
hyper 
theta 
hyperid 90001 
name logit probability 
short.name prob 
initial -1 
fixed FALSE 
prior gaussian param -1 0.2 
to.theta function(x) log(x/(1-x)) 
from.theta function(x) exp(x)/(1+exp(x))

My understanding is that this means the prior for \theta ~ N(-1,0.2).  What would be the priors for the intercept and coefficient if we fit:

\theta=\alpha+\beta* x ?

Thanks and best wishes!

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Default priors for poisson hurdle model
parts:
On Thu, 2016-07-14 at 14:42 -0700, Laina Mercer wrote:
> 
> My understanding is that this means the prior for \theta ~ N(-1,0.2).
>  What would be the priors for the intercept and coefficient if we
> fit:
>

yes, theta is N(-1, precision = 0.2).

and prob = exp(theta)/(1+exp(theta))
